defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-1607 with the actual opinion passage supporting the rule, or remove the pin until an exact quote and page pin can be harvested. Also avoid typographic changes inside quotation marks unless normalized by policy.

defect.proposed_fix: Retain the proposition, but repair the pin record by storing a normalized/reflowed source quote with an auditable position, or quote a passage that is exact in the cached text. Add separate pins for the other direct quotes bundled under the same content-page pin.

reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use one pin per quoted passage and preserve a normalized source-text span so future quote checks can distinguish pagination artifacts from real mismatches.
